lessonPlan.title: Rainy Day Sensory
lessonPlan.weeklyOverview: A short rainy-day exploration week for toddlers.
lessonPlan.objectives:
Explore water play safely.
Practice describing words.

books.title: Rain
books.author: Sample Author
books.notes:
Before: What do you wear in the rain?
During: What sound does rain make?
After: Can you show me dripping fingers?

songs.title: Pitter Patter Raindrops
songs.notes:
Lyrics: Pitter patter raindrops, falling all around.
Motions: tap fingers → wiggle arms → crouch small

lessonPlan.weeklyMaterials:
Sensory bin
Water
Cups
Towels
Rain picture cards
lessonPlan.vocabularyWords:
Rain — water that falls from clouds. Ask: What do we wear in the rain?
Puddle — a small pool of water. Ask: Can we stomp gently?
lessonPlan.observationOpportunities: Watch for describing words and careful pouring.
lessonPlan.familyConnection: Today we explored rain and water play! Ask your child to show a pitter-patter finger rain and tell you one thing we wear outside when it rains.

transitions: Tip-toe like quiet rain to wash hands
monday.familyConnection: Ask about rain gear at pickup.

items.title: Rain Sensory Bin
items.setup: Fill bin with shallow water. Place cups and towels nearby.
items.steps:
1. Invite children to the tray.
2. Model slow pouring.
3. Narrate splash and drip words.
items.teacherLanguage:
Look: What happens when you pour slowly?
Wonder: Where did the water go?
Care: How can we keep towels ready?
items.observationOpportunities:
Pours with control?
Uses rain words?
items.adaptations: Use less water for hesitant children.

items.title: Raindrop Dot Painting
items.setup: Set paper and paint dots on tray.
items.steps:
1. Show a raindrop shape.
2. Invite dabbing.
3. Count drops together.
items.teacherLanguage: Look: Are your drops big or tiny?
